rationale.risk-routing: Operationalized thresholds route findings among automation, warnings, blocking, and human review.
rationale.ai-review: Multi-LLM ensemble judges vulnerabilities and quantifies reviewer disagreement and reliability.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Confidence scores and natural-language reasoning help humans judge security findings.
rationale.framework: Reusable multi-stage architecture integrates vulnerability triage into CI/CD pipelines.
rationale.built-system: Implemented ensemble was evaluated across 395 labeled vulnerability examples.
rationale.general-code: Reviews general vulnerable code rather than specifically AI-generated code.
rationale.metrics: Defines security confidence, agreement, calibration, and composite trust scores.
rationale.risk-security: Contributes and evaluates software-vulnerability detection and triage mitigation.
